McIntosh, Andrew Elphinstone Sinclair, B.Sc., Ph.D. (Edin.).—B. 1903; ed. Edin. Univ., B.Sc. (1st cls. hons., botany); asst. plant pathologist to bd. of agr. for Scotland, 1925-27; Ph.D. (Edin.), 1927; geneticist to dept. of sci. and agr., Barbados, B.W.I., 1928.

MacKay, R., M.B., Ch.B., D.P.H. (Aberd.)—B. 1898; war serv., R.N.R., 1916-19; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Aug., 1926; malaria research offr., 1931.

Mackay, William Harold.—B. 1893; offr., cust. and excise, Cyprus, 1913; asst. collr. and harbr., 1916; collr., cust., 1921; ag. ch. collr., cust. and excise, June to Oct., 1925; ag. comptr., cust. and excise, June to Oct., 1928 and June to Oct., 1931; ag. regr., companies, ag. regr., trade marks, ag. regr., patents, in 1926, 1928 and 1931; ag. comsnr., Sept., to Oct., 1928; dep. comptr., cust. and excise, 1931.

McKag, Capt. V. M.—Asst. dist. comsnr., Kenya, May, 1920; ag. sec., secretariat, 1927.

McKean, J. D.—Asst. dist. comsnr., E.A.P., Jan., 1917; ag. dist. comsnr., Kenya, 1926.

McKechnie, Robert McKechnie, M.I.Mech.E.—B.1875; ed. Cheltenham Coll. and Univ. Coll. (Lond.); loco. dept., L.S.W.R., 1896; engrg. inspr., C.A., 1906; asst. engrg., 1919; dep. head, engrg. inspection dept., 1922.

McKenzie, P. J.—B. 1891; ed. Christian Bros. Schl., Belfast; warehouse supervisor, Nigeria, 1915; asst. traffic surt., Nigerian rly., 1918; ditto, 2nd grade, 1920; asst. divnl. supt. (traffic), 1923.

McKenzie, A., M.R., B.S., I.M.S.S.A., D.T.M. & H. (Lond.), Cert. Lond. S.H.T.M. (distinct), and Duncan Med.—B. 1898; war serv., R.N.V.R., 1917-18; med. offr., Cook Is., 1922; do., Tanganyika Territory, Aug., 1926.

Mackenzie-Kennedy, Henry Charles Donald Cleveland, C.M.G. (1932).—B. 1889; ed. Marlborough and Clare Coll., Cambridge, B.A., 1911; probationer, dist. adminstr., N. Rhodesia,
Dec., 1912; asst. native comntr., June, 1915; native comntr., July, 1918; ag. asst. mag., Apr.-June, 1923; seconded to dept. of native affrs., Apr., 1926; asst. mag., Apr., 1926; represented N. Rhodesia at Imp. educn. confere., 1927; prin. asst. ch. sec., Sept., 1927; ag. D.P.W., Apr. to May, 1928; ch. sec., Oct., 1930; mem., exec. and leg. couns.; ag. gov., Aug., 1931 and from Sept. to Nov., 1932.

McKERRON, PATRICK ALEXANDER BRUCE.—B. 1896; ed. Fettes Coll., Edin.; 2nd lieut. Gordon Highrs., 1914; capt., 1916; transfd., I.A.R.O., 1917; capt., 20th Punjab, 1918; demob., Feb., 1919; cadet, S.S., Feb., 1920; passed cadet, Mar., 1922; offr., cls. V., Mar., 1923; dist. offr., N. Tsalal, Dec., 1924; offr., cls. IV., Mar., 1927; Br. res., Brunei, May, 1928; attd., fedl. seott., Oct., 1931; sec., trentrenchment comntr., F.M.S., Mar., 1932; offr., cls. III., Mar., 1932.

MACKIE, A. S., M.B., Ch.B. (Aberd.)—B. 1891; war serv., R.N., 1915-19; med. offr., Kenya, Sept., 1919; senr. med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Apr., 1929.

MACKIE, GEORGE DOUGLAS, M.B.E. (1923).—Ag. 2nd clk., govt. office, St. Vincent, Dec., 1890, to Apr., 1891; 2nd clk. and cashier, treasy., Apr., 1891, to May, 1892, and from Jan., 1897 to Oct., 1898; clk., crown lands and survey office, May to Dec., 1892; audit clk., Jan., 1893, to Dec., 1896; 2nd clk. and acctnt., treasy., Grenada, Nov., 1898; ch. clk., Jan., 1903; ch. sub-clkrr. and revenue offr., treasy., St. Lucia, Jan., 1911; ag. treas. on several occasions in 1911 to 1916; treas., Nov., 1915; ag. col. sec. in 1923, 1924 and 1925; admstd. govt., July to Sept., 1925.

MACKIE, JAMES RICHARD, B.Sc. (Agric.)—B. 1896; ed. Saxey's Sch., Bruton, Somerset and Univ. Coll., Reading; supt., agr., Nigeria, 1921; dep. senr. dir., agr., Nigeria, 1928; asst. dir., agr., 1929.

MOKINNEY, E. H.—B. 1877; ent. Bahamas civ. ser., 1898; 2nd clk., P.O., 1901; res. just., Exuma, 1904; Out Island comntr. (2nd div.), 1909; comntr. (1st div.), 1912; senr. comntr., 1928; ag. stip. and circuit mag. in 1931 and 1932.

MACKINNON, WILLIAM LUNAN, M.A. (Aberdeen), 1911.—B. 1883; asst. audr., G. Coast, Nov., 1912; ag. senr. asst. audr., in 1918 and 1919; ag. asst. treas. (in addition to his own duties), May to Sept., 1919; ag. senr. asst. audr., Oct., 1919; ag. dep. audr. on various occasions, 1926-29; ag. audr., May-Oct., 1930; senr. asst. audr., Nigeria, Oct., 1930.

MCKINSTRY, SIDNEY ALEXANDER ROGER.—B. 1901; ed. Ashford, Kent; called to bar (Lincoln's Inn), 1930; supernmry. sub-inspr., pol., Leeward Is., 1920; sub-inspr., St. Kitts-Nevis, 1921; sub-inspr. and offr. instr., local forces, Antigua, 1924; sub-inspr., Montserrat, O.C.L., forces, offr. in ch., pris. and supt., fire brig., 1924; mag. and coroner, regist.-gen., regist., sup. ct., escheator gen., etc., Montserrat, 1928; dep. judge, Leeward Is., 1929; mem., exec. coun., Montserrat, 1928; chmn., prison justices, 1929; admstd. govt. of Montserrat, 1929; dist. comntr., Belize, Br. Honduras and offr. admstr. and offr. rear., 1930; ag. atty.-gen., Dec., 1930 to Feb., 1931 and from Mar., 1931.

MACLACHLAN, HON. ALEXANDER JOHN.—B. 1872; ed. Adelaide Univ.; called to bar, 1895; el. O'wealth senator for S. Australia, Nov., 1925; hon. min., Aug., 1926; ag. atty.-gen., 1926-27; plenipotentiary for Australia for signing of Kellogg Pact, 1928; vice-pres., exec. coun., Lyons' ministry, 1932.

MACLACHLAN, JAMES BOYD, M.C., M.Sc., B.E., A.M.I.C.E. Chartered Civil Engnr.—B. 1886; on active serv., Canadian F.A., 1915-19; M.C., 1917; mentd. in desp., 1918; asst. engrnr., P.W.D., F.M.S., Apr., 1919; exec. engrnr., P.W.D., Apr., 1928; ag. sr. exec. engrnr., 1929.

MACLLIN, MAJOR RODERIC WILLIAM, M.C., A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1891; serv. with R. Artillery in the Gt. War, 1914-18; travelling comntr., Gambia, Mar., 1920.

MAOLAREN, JOHN SUTHERLAND, M.A. (hons.).—B. 1900; Fettes Coll. and Edin. Univ.; M.A. (hons. class.), 1921; Fettes exhibn., Lanfine schol., Ritchie schol., 1st equal Grey Essay Prize, 1922; cadet, Hong Kong, 1923; ag. 3rd and 2nd ast. to sec. for Chinese affrs., 1924; passed in Cantonese, Dec., 1925; ast. treas. and ast. assessor, 1926; ast. estate duty comntr., 1927; 2nd ast. to sec. for Chinese affrs., 1928; ast. dist. offr., N. and S. dists., New Territories, 1929; ast. treas., 1930; dist. offr., South, 1931.

MACLAREN, COL. THE HON. MURRAY, C.A.M.C., C.M.G., L.L.D., M.D., C.M., M.R.C.S., F.A.C.S., Commander of Order of St. John of Jerusalem, also of Order of Avia Portugal.—B. 1861; ed. Grammar Schol., St. John, N. B.; univ. of New Brunswick; Edinburgh univ., Vienna; served overseas, 1914-19; 1st cl. to H. of C., Canada, 1921; re-cl. at g. e., 1925 and 1926; min. of pensions and national health in Bennett adminstr., 1930.

MACLEAN, ADRIAN JOHN.—Ed. at Selwyn Coll., Camb., B.A., 1895; M.A., 1901; ast. collr., E. Africa Prot., May, 1901; collr., Apr., 1905; recorder of titles, 1911; senr. comntr., Kenya, May, 1920.

MACLEAN, F.H.—B. 1889; apptd. after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div., and assigned to bd. of educn., May, 1908; transfd. to C.O., Dec., 1911; on military serv., from 25th Apr., 1917, to 23rd Feb., 1919; cler.offr., higher grade, 24th Jan., 1922.

MACLEAN, G., M.B., Ch.B. (Glas.), M.B.E. (1928).—B. 1888; temp. lieut., R.A.M.C., Mar., 1918 to Mar., 1919; temp. capt., Mar., 1919 to June, 1920; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Apr., 1921; sleeping sickness offr., Apr., 1926.

MACLEAN, SIMON JAMES, M.A., LL.B., Ph.D.—B. 1871; comntr. of the Canadian govt. to report on rly. rate grievances, 1901; advar. to comm. of govt. to draft Railway Act, 1903; prof. of polit. econ., Toronto Univ., 1906-1908; apptd. a mem. of rly. comn., Canada, 1908; re-apptd., Nov., 1918; ast. chief comntr., Aug., 1919.

MACLENNAN, FINLAY MALCOLM.—B. 1887; ed., Tarbutt Public Schol.; Sault Ste. Marie, Ont., High Schol.; ast. serv. of dept. of rlys. and canals, Can., as officerman, Sault Ste. Marie Canal, Sept., 1910; transferred, Port Nelson on Hudson Bay terminals work, as jnr. engrnr., 1912; ast. audr., dept., rlys. and canals, Ottawa, 1st Apr., 1915; audr., 1917; ch. audr., 1918; ast. comptfr., 1920; comptfr., 1930.

MACLENNAN, NORMAN MACPHERSON.—B. 1895; ed. Waitaki College (N.Z.) and Aberdeen Univ.; M.D., Ch.B., D.P.H., D.T.M. & H. (Eng.); war serv., 1915-18; res. med. offr., City Hosp., Aberdeen, 1922; bacteriologist, James Mackenzie Inst., St. Andrews and M.O.H., St. Andrews, 1923; ast. M.O.H. and tuberculosis offr., Woolwich, 1925; health offr., Kenya, 1927; senr. med. offr., Palestine, 1929; senr. health offr., N. Rhodesia, 1931.
McLEOD, David William, M.A.—B. 1887; ed. Aberdeen Cent. Training Coll. and Aberdeen Univ.; senr. asst., King's Coll., Seychelles, 1910; prin., King's Coll. and inspr., schls., Seychelles, 1913; on active serv., 1914-19; senr. asst., King Edward VII Schl., Taiping, Feb., 1920; prin., King Edward VII Schl., Taiping, Jan., 1922; prin., Free Schl., Penang, Dec., 1930; prin., Raffles Inst., S'pore, 1932.

MACLEOD, J. R. S.—B. 1887; ed. Scots Coll., Ballarat and Cambridge, B.A., LL.B., F.S.A., Scotland; called to bar, Middle Temple, 1921; lieut., Australian Citizens Forces, 1914; served overseas as 2nd lieut., Australian Imp. Forces, 1915; capt., 1918 (wounded, despatched twice); temp. clk., F.O., 1921; asst. commr., national savings comittee, 1922; after compet. exam. apptd. asst. prin., Overseas Sttmt. Dept., 1924.

MCLUCKIE, WILLIAM HARLEY, A.M.Inst.C.E.—B. 1896; ed. Greenock High Schol., Royal Tech. Coll., Glasgow; mily. serv., 1915-19; asst. engr., P.W.D., Tanganyika Territory, 1922; exec. engr., 1928; ag. dep. dir., pub. wks., in 1930, 1931 and 1932.

McMAHON, CECIL.—Ent. S. Rhodesia civ. serv., Nov., 1909; served S. African rebellion and German S.W. African campaign, 1914-15 with 1st Rhodesian regt.; E. Africa campaign with 8th S. African Inf., 1915-18; capt. and adjt., "1914-15" Star and M.C.; asst. polit. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Mar., 1918; dist. offr., June, 1926.

MACMILLAN, HON. CHARLES EDWARD DE LA BARCA.—B. 1872; ed. Brighton pub. schl. and priv.; ent. N.Z. H. of R., 1923; min. of agr. and mines, 1932.

McMILLAN, SIR DANIEL HUNTER, K.C.M.G. (1902).—B. 1846; ed. Canada; served with Canadian Volunteers on Niagara frontier, 1864; during Fenian raid, 1866; Red River expedit., 1870; N.W. rebellion (medal), 1885; mem. for Winnipeg in Manitoba legislature, 1889; mem. of Manitoba govt., 1889; lt. gov. of Manitoba, Sept., 1900; re-apptd. for second term, 1906; ret. 1911.

McMILLAN, L. B.—B. 1873; ed. pub. schls., Charlottetown, Prince Edward Is.; messenger, P.E. Is. govt., 1890; clk., 1893; sec. for pub. wk., P.E. Is., 1900.

McNAMARA, GEORGE, C.B.E. (1932).—B. 1881; entd. N.Z. post and tel. dept., 1896; supt. of staff, 1916; 2nd asst. sec., 1920; 1st asst. sec., 1923; sec., 1926.

MACNIE, WILLIAM ALEXANDER.—B. 1899; 2nd lieut., Seaforth Highrs., 1918; lieut., 1919-20; served, France, 1918; sub-inspr., pol., B. Guiana, 1921; dist. inspr., 1925; ag. detective inspr., 1925; ag. pol. inspr., 1926, 1928-31; seconded to col. secretariat as addnl. asst. col. sec., May, 1931; dist. commr., Jan., 1932.

McNULTY, THOS. SYDNEY.—B. 1870; ed. at Marist Coll., Sydney; clk., ascts. branch, wks. dept., Perth, W. Australia, 1896; ch. corresp. clk. ditto, 1897; mem. mun. coun., Claremont, 1901-3; sec. to goldfields water supply admnstr., 1903; under-sec. for agric. and industries, 1909.

McPHAIL, NEIL, M.R.San.l., M.R., San. Assoc. (Scot.).—B. 1887; ch. sany. inspr., sany. bd., K. Lumpur, May, 1913.

McPHEE, JOHN CAMERON.—B. 1878; premier of Tasmania since 1st June, 1928.

MACPHERSON, BARBARA.—Ed. Durness H.G. Schol. and Skerry's Coll., Edinburgh; apptd. after compet. exam. typist, Lond. tel. serv., 1912; transf. to C.O., May, 1918; shorthandwriter, Aug., 1918; cler. offr., Jan., 1923.

MACPHERSON, BRUCE WHYTE.—B. 1891; ed. Liverpool Coll.; capt., 4th batt., The King's Regt., 1913; asst. dist. offr., Nigeria, Apr., 1914; attd. Nigeria Regt., Cameroon, Oct., 1914 and May-June, 1915; dist. offr., 1924; marshal to L.C.J. of England with permission of S. of S. while on leave, 1926; res., 1930; called to bar, Gray's Inn, 1931.

MACPHERSON, COLIN, R. OF O., K.A.R.—B. 1898; ed. Alleyne's Coll., Dulwich; cadet, Tanganyika Territory, Oct., 1926; asst. dist. offr., Jan., 1929.

MCPHILLIPS, HON. ALBERT EDWARD.—B. 1861; ed. St. Boniface and Manitoba Colls.; barrister; K.C., 1900; elected to leg. assem., B.C., 1898; atty.-gen., 1903; subsequently pres. of coun.; judge, ct. of appeal, B.C., 1913; served N.W. rebellion under Gen. Middleton, 1885.

MOQUADE, JOHN HERBERT.—B. 1893; highest marks in U.K. in entrance exam. for cust. and excise, Mar., 1913; Imp. cust. and excise, July, 1913; served in Flanders with R. Arty. and Chapperton Down Arty. schl. with R. Engrs.; asst., cust., Kenya, July, 1920; coilor., cust., Aug., 1924; ag. dep. commr., cust., Mar., 1928; dep. contr., cust., Tanganyika Territory, July, 1930; ag. compt., cust., 1931.

MACQUARRIE, EDMUND JEFFREY.—B. 1883; ed. Queen's Coll., B. Guiana and Caius Coll., Cambridge; B.A., L.B.B., 1905; called to the bar, Inner Temp., 1906; ag., stip. mag., B. Guiana, June to Nov., 1906, and July, 1907 to Mar., 1914; dormant comm., as stip. mag. and apptd. J.P. and commr. of oaths, Dec., 1907; asst. dist. commr., Gold Coast, 1915; crown counsel, 1916; ag. chief regar., Apr.-May, 1917; ag. senr. crown counsel, 1917; ag. pol. mag., Nov., 1917 to Apr., 1918; ag. solr.-gen., Apr. to Dec., 1919; ag. ch. regar., Apr. to Oct., 1919; solr.-gen., Tanganyika Territory, Sept., 1920; ag. atty.-gen. in 1923, 1924 and 1927; puisne and circuit judge, Sierra Leone, 1931.

MACQUILLAN, CECIL JAMES, B.A., M.B., B.Ch. (T.C.Dublin).—M.O., R.A.F.(res); served U.K. and Irak, 1924-26; R.M.O., Kent and Canterbury hosp., 1926; medl. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Nov., 1927.

MACRAE, LACHLAN, M.A. (Aberdeen), M.A. (Cantab).—B. 1886; dir., educn., Ceylon, Jan., 1922; M.L.C.

McROBERTS, CAPT. B. A.K.—Natal mounted pol., 1903-08; Natal rebellion, 1906; Usutu operations, 1907; inspr., veterinary pol., E.A.P., 1909; asst. inspr., pol., Mar., 1910; asst. supr., Sept., 1911; capt., Gordon Highlanders, Aug., 1915; France, 1916; called to bar, Middle Temple, Jan., 1917; attd., Highland Light Inf'y., Mesopotamia, Mar., 1917; seconded, polit. dept., dist. mag. and dep. mily. govt., Basrah, 1917-18; mily. mission to Siberian govt., 1919; supr., pol., Kenya Colony, May, 1920; mag., Zanzibar Prot., Jan., 1921; ag. asst. judge, in 1922 and 1924; ag. atty.-gen., Feb. to Sept., 1925; pol. mag., Sierra Leone, Apr., 1926.

McSWEENEY, D. C. J.—B. 1903; ed. Christ's Coll., Cambridge (schol.); Ist ols., English tripso, June, 1923; Ist ols., original languages tripso, June, 1925; apptd. after compet. exam. astt. prin., W.O., 17th Oct., 1925; transf. to C.O., 11th Oct., 1926; seconded to Uganda adminstr., 10th Apr., 1929; asst. prte. sec. to the S. of S. for the ols. (Lord Passfield) 23rd Mar., 1931;
pvte. sec. to perm. U.S. of S. for the cols., 1st Oct., 1931; ag. prin., 18th Apr., 1932.

MOTURK, WILLIAM HENRY, F.S.I.—B. 1883; survr. ast., dept. lands and mines, Br. Guiana, Nov., 1901; land survr., 1904; 2nd cls. offr. and gov't. survr., 1906; J.P., 1908; land offr., Pomeroon dist., 1910; drawing office ast., Jan., 1919; ag. ast. comanr., lands and mines, Apr. to Nov., 1920 and May to July, 1923; in char., dept. lands and mines, June to July, 1920; ch. clk., 1922; land offr. and survr., Gambia, Nov., 1924.

MACWILLIAM, DONALD KIRTON, M.B.E. (1926).—2nd clk., treas., St. Kitts, 1894; rev. offr. and quarantine offr., Apr., 1894; rev. offr. and harb. mast., 1906; 1st rev. offr. and harb. mast., 1st Apr., 1915; mem., poor law bd., Mar., 1918; mem., quarantine bd., St. Kitts, 3rd May, 1921; sp. serv. in connection with small-pox epidemic and quarantine measures.

MAGILL, CHARLES VICTOR.—Ast. dir., posts and tels., Somaliland, Nov., 1919; dir., posts and tels., Somaliland, Apr., 1926.

MAGRATH, CHARLES ALEXANDER.—B. 1860; ed., priv. tuition; irrig. and development work in S. Alberta from 1878; mem. for Lethbridge in N.W.T. assem. for several years, and finally mem. of prov. cabinet; ed. to H.C., Can., 1908, for Medicine Hat; def., 1911; fuel contr., Can., 1917-20; chmn., Internatl. Joint Coman., Can. sect., 1921.

MAHABIR, F.—B. 1888; ast. med. supt., lunatic asylum, Trinidad, 7th Apr., 1916.

MAHONY, DAVID BERNARD, M.R.C.V.S.—B. 1893; ed. Blackrock Coll. and R. Vety. Coll., Dublin; vety. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Feb., 1921.

MAINGOT, ELLIOT FRANCIS.—B. 1891; ed. Ushaw Coll., Durham; served articles of clerkship in London and qualified as solr., 1914; crown solr., admstr. gen. and offr. receiver, Trinidad, Dec., 1922; pub. trustee, May, 1931.

MAJOR, ALFRED REGINALD SEYMOUR.—B. 1909; ed. St. John's, Leatherhead; pol. probationer, Hong Kong, Nov., 1929; ast. supt., pol., Dec., 1931.

MAJOR, SIR CHARLES, KT. BACH. (1911).—Called to the Bar (Mid. Temp.), June, 1887; mem. of Leeward Is. bar, Sept., 1887; chancellor of the diocese of Antigua, Oct., 1889; nominated mem. of legia. coun., Antigua, 1895 to 1899; nominated mem. of gen. legis-coun., Leewards, Nov., 1896, and pres. of same, Dec., 1896 to 1899; mem. fed. ex. couns., Leewards, Mar., 1897, to June, 1901; vice-pres. legis. coun., Antigua, May, 1897; ag. sol.-gen. and atty.-gen., Leewards, 1897, 1898, 1899; capt. commanding Antigua volunteer defence force on its establishment, 1897; J.P., 1897; ag. 2nd puisne judge, Leewards, June, 1899; atty.-gen. of Grenada, 1901; oh. just. of Fiji, and chief judicial comanr. of Western Pacific, 1902; admstd. govt., Mar., Oct., 1904, and in 1908, 1910, and 1912; chief just., B. Guiana, 1914; ret., 1926.

MALAN, HON. D. F., M.A., D.D.—M.L.A., Calvinia Divn., Union of S. Africa; min. of int. pub. health and educn., June, 1924.

MALAN, RT. HON. FRANCOIS STEPHANUS, P.O. (1920).—B. 1871; ed. in S. Africa and Camb.; B.A. Science, Cape univ.; LL.B., Camb.; advocate of sup. ct., Cape Colony, 1896; M.L.A. for Malmsbury, 1900; re-elected, Feb., 1904; min. of agric., Cape Colony, 1908; min. of educn., Union of South Africa, 1910; attended Imp. conf., 1911; min. of mines, industries and educn., 1912; min. for agr., 1920; min. of mines and industries, 1921-24; senator, 1927.

MALAN, FRANCOIS STEPHANUS.—B. 1882; ed. Normal Coll., Capetown and Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch, R.A.; inspr. wchls., Transvaal, 1916; prin., Normal Coll., Ernemo, Transvaal, 1919; sec., Transvaal educn. dept., 1924.

MALCOLM, HARQUIST GLADSTONE, O.B.E. (1918); K.C. (1910).—Priv. sec. to Sir Henry Jackson when adminstr. of Bahamas, 1892, 1893, 1895; ditto to Sir W. F. Haynes-Smith, gov. of Bahamas, 1895; called to the bar, Lincoln's Inn, June, 1899; ditto, Bahamas, July, 1899; mem. of H. of A., Bahamas, 1900; deputy-speaker, 1901; re-elected, 1904 and 1911; ag. atty.-gen., Aug. to Nov., 1905; Sept., 1906 to Feb., 1907; July to Nov., 1910; Apr. to Dec., 1911; May to July, and Aug. to Nov., 1913; ag. chief just., 1913 and 1927; speaker, H. of A., 1913; re-elected, 1913, 1919, 1927 and 1928; thanked by S. of S. for assistance to atty.-gen. in drafting bills; thanked by legia. for obtaining copies of early records; Bahamas del. to Canada-W. Indies confoces. at Ottawa, 1920 and 1925; Bahamas rep. during visit of Prince of Wales, and parly. ter-centenary celebrations at Bermuda, Oct., 1920; Bahamas del. to W. Indian confoc., London, 1926; prepared 1929 revised edition of the laws of Bahamas.

MALHERBE, JOZEA FRANCOIS.—B. 1880; clk., dept. of just., Transvaal, 1900; clk., commr. of pol., 1902; 1st gde. clk. and A.R.M., dept. of just., 1908; pub. pros., Kimberley, 1912; senr. clk., dep. of just., 1920; mag., Wynberg, 1921; addtl. mag., Pretoria, 1925; mem., wage bd., 1926; pub. serv. inspr., 1930.

MALONE, DENIS KERON.—B. 1903; ed. Cooper's Company Schl.; cler. offr., C.O., 29th Mar., 1921.

MANDERS, RICHARD HENRY DAVID, B.A. (Cantab.).—B. 1904; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Jan., 1927; attd., secretariat, Feb., 1927; attd., Kandy kach., Oct., 1927; ag. office ast., Kurunegala kach., May, 1928; office ast., ditto Feb., 1929; ditto, Kandy kach., May, 1930; addnl. pol. mag., Colombo, Dec., 1931; ast. ch. sec., Apr., 1932.

MANGAN, WILLIAM EDWARD.—Served in Bechuanaaland Prot. pol., 1910-14; olk., 1914; ag. ast. res. mag., 1921; passed 2nd grade Secwana exam., 1917; ag. res. mag., 1922.

MANGIN, THORLEIF RATTRAY ORDE.—B. 1896; ed. Marlborough Coll.; sub-lieut., R.N.V.R. and attd. to Royal Naval Dvn., 1915; qualified, gunnery course, H.M.S. Excellent, 1916; apptd., to H.M.S. Repulse and served with Grand Fleet, 1916-1919; ast. dist. comanr., Gold Coast, 1919.

MANION, HON. ROBERT JAMES, M.C., M.D., C.M. (Toronto), L.R.C.P. (Edin.), L.F.P. and S. (Glasgow).—B. 1881; ed. Fort William and l'ort Arthur High Schls.; Trinity, Toronto, and Edinburgh Univ.; ed. to H.C., Canada, at g.e., 1917; min. of soldiers civ. re-estab., 1921; re-el., g.e., 1921 and 1925; P.M.G., in Meighen cabinet, 1926; re-el., g.e., 1926; min. of rlys. and canals in Bennett cabinet, 1930.

MANN, GEORGE ERNEST, M.C., M.A. (Cantab.).—B. 1896; ast. agrl. inspr., F.M.S., Sept., 1921; agrl. field offr., Nov., 1924; agrl. instr., Dec., 1926; vice-prin., schl. of agr., Malaya, Apr., 1931.

MANNING, RICHARD JOSEPH.—B. 1883; ed. Clongowes Wood Coll. and Univ. Coll., Dublin; sub-inspr. of police, B. Guiana,
Oct., 1909; dist. inspr., Sept., 1912; ag. stip. mag., W. Coast, Demarara, June, 1919; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, June, 1920; mag., Tanganyika Territory, Sept., 1920; res. mag., Jamaica, July, 1925; pol. mag., Gold Coast, Nov., 1927; ag. ch. regiar. on various occasions, 1928-31; ag. circuit judge, Ashanti and N.Territories judiciary, July, 1930; 3rd puisane judge, Trinidad, 1932; higher certif. in Hindi, Mar., 1916; higher certif., Swahili, 1922; lower certif., Ga., 1928; compiler, "Br. Guiana Police Manual," Dec., 1918.

MANNING, WILLIAM.—B. 1892; on active serv., Sept., 1914 to Feb., 1919; inspr., pol., Zanzibar, Mar., 1919; supdt., 1924; ag. astt., commdt., on various occasions, 1926-32.

MANSERGH, N. S., M.B.E.—B. 1889; ed. Wellington Coll.; B.S.A. pol., 1910; Rhodesia Native Regt., 1917; lieut., 1917; demob., 1919; dist. pol. offr., Somaliland, 1919; operns. against Mad Mullah, 1920; astt. comsnr., pol., Gold Coast, 1921; comsnr., pol., 1926; comsnr., pol., crim. investig. dept., 1927.

MANSON, A. G. B., B.A., LL.B. (Oxon.).—B. 1894; ed. Dulwich and Wadham Coll., Oxford; 2nd cls. hons., jurisprudence, 1912; lieut., Lancashire Fusiliers, 1914-19; barrister-at-law, Inner Temple, 1919; Oxford circuit; pol. mag., Gambia, 1928; legal adviser, 1929; ag. judge on various occasions.

MARCH, HARRY THOMAS.—B.1881; ed. King's Coll., London; 2nd divn. clk., post office, 1900-07; acctnt., post office, Nigeria, Apr., 1907 to Jan., 1912; postmtr.-gen., Sierra Leone, Feb., 1912.

MARCHANT, W. S.—Astt. dist. comsnr., E. Africa Prot., Dec., 1918; ag. dist. comsnr., Kenya, 1926.

MARCEL, HON. CHARLES, LL.D., Ottawa Univ.—B. 1860; elec. to H. of C. of Canada for Bonaventure, 1900; dep. speaker of H. of C., 1905-1908; re-elec. at gen. elec., 1908, 1911, 1917, and 1921; speaker of the H. of C., 1909; mem. of P.C. for Canada, 1911.

MARILLIER, ERIC STANLEY.—B. 1890; clk., cust., N. Rhodesia, Apr., 1912; collr. cust., Apr., 1915; senr. collr. cust., Oct., 1926; contr. cust., Mar., 1928; mem., leg. coun.

MARITZ, G. J.—B. 1889; ed. Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch and Trinity Coll., Oxford; called to bar, Middle Temple, 1912; pres. sp. income tax appl., 1926; judge, sup. ct., Transvaal prov. divn., 1930.

MARR, MAJOR THE HON. CHARLES WILLIAM CLANNAN, D.S.O., M.C., V.D., M.P.—B. 1880; served in European war with Australian and N.Z. wireless squadron in Mesopotamia (ment. in desps. four times); M.H.R., C wealth of Australia since Dec., 1929; hon. min., 1928-27; ag. min. for defence, 1926; sec. to Canberra parly. com. from 1929; min. for home and territories, 1927-29; min. for health and works and sec. to cabinet, Lyons' ministry, 1932.

MARRIOTT, FREDERICK CLAUDE, O.B.E. (1930), M.A. (Cantab.), L.C.P.—B. 1876; 4th astt. mast., Queen's Royal Coll., Trinidad, May, 1905; inspr. of imigts., Oct., 1913; ag. prot. of imigts., May, 1917; man. of lab. exchanges, 1919; served on wages comte. and profiteering comte., 1920; ag. dir. educn., May, 1920, to Jan., 1921 and from Dec., 1921 to Apr., 1922; astt. dir. of educn., schls., 1922; dir. of educn., Sierra Leone, May, 1923; dir. educn., Trinidad, Mar., 1926.

MARRS, ROBERT, M.A. (Oxon.), C.I.E.—B. 1884; prin., Ceylon Univ. Coll., Sept., 1921.

MARDEN, ERNEST, D.Sc., M.C. (1918).—B. 1889; ed. Queen Elizabeth Gram. Sch., Blackburn, and Univ. of Manchester; lect., Univ. of London, 1911; fellow, Univ. of Manchester, 1912; prof., Victoria Univ. Coll., N.Z., 1915; astt. dir. of educn., N.Z., 1922; sec., dept. of scientific and indus. research, 1926; served in Great War.

MARDEN, HERBERT, B.Sc. (Manq.), A.I.C.—B. 1887; astt. chem., inst. med. resech., F.M.S., Jan., 1914; chem., trade and cust. dept., F.M.S., Aug., 1928.

MARSH, EDWARD HOWARD, C.B., C.M.G., M.V.O.—B. 1872; ed. at Westminster and Cambridge; scholar, Trin. Coll., 1891; 1st cl. classical tripos, 1893; sen. chancellor's medal for classics, 1895; 1st cl. with distinction classical tripos, Part II., and B.A., 1895; M.A., 1897; apptd., after compet. exam., 2nd cl. elk., C.O., Sept. 29th, 1896; astt. priv. sec. to Mr. Chamberlain, July, 1900; to Mr. Lyttelton, Oct., 1903; 1st cls. clk., 1st Apr., 1905; priv. sec. to Mr. Winston Churchill, U.S. of S. for the Colonies, Jan., 1907; accompanied Mr. Churchill on his visit to E. Africa and Uganda, 1907-8; priv. sec. to Mr. Churchill as Pres. of B. of T., 1908; priv. sec. to Mr. Churchill as Home Sec., 1910; priv. sec. to Mr. Churchill as first Lord of the Admiralty, 1911; priv. sec. to Mr. Churchill as Chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster, June to Nov., 1915; priv. sec. to Mr. Asquith, first lord of treasury, 16th Nov., 1915; returned to C.O. as 1st cls. clk., Dec., 1916; priv. sec. to Mr. Churchill as min. of munitions, July, 1917; priv. sec. to Mr. Churchill, as sec. of state for war, Jan., 1919, as S. of S. for the Colonies, Feb., 1921 and as chancellor of exchequer, 7th Nov., 1924; priv. sec. to the Duke of Devonshire, Oct., 1922; priv. sec. to Mr. J. H. Thomas, 23rd Jan., 1924; priv. sec. to Mr. Churchill as Chancellor of the Exchequer, Nov., 1925; pvt. sec. to Mr. J. H. Thomas as Lord Privy Seal, and afterwards as S. of S. for Dom. affrs., Dec., 1929; pvt. sec. to Mr. J. H. Thomas as S. of S. for Dom. affrs. and for the cols., 26th Aug., 1931.

MARSH, LEWIS ARTHUR.—B. 1878; cust. baggage offr., 1901; astt. cashier, 1902; ch. clk., Pretoria, 1905; act., 1907; active serv., S.A.H.A., 1917-19; collr., cust., Job's burg, 1922; collr., cust. and shipping mast., Durban, 1928; dep. commr., cust. and excise, 1930.

MARSHALL, CLAUDE H., M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P.—Med. offr., Uganda Prot., Apr., 1908; famine relief duty, May-Aug., 1908; sleeping sickness work at Kryetume and Sesse camps, Sept., 1908, to July, 1909; med. offr., Toro and Mbarara, Sept., 1909, to May, 1910; med. offr., Anglo-German-Belgian Boundary Coman., Jan., 1911, to Sept., 1912; med. supt., sleeping sickness measures, 1913-14; active serv., 1914; capt. U.M.S., O.C., Uganda field ambulances; addt. 4th Lond. gen. hosp., May-Dec., 1917; D.M.O., Uganda, 1918; S.M.O., 1920; R.S.O., 1924.

MARSHALL, C. W.—Imp. serv., 1897-98; clk., atty.-gen.'s dept., Cape Town, 1898; examr., accnts., 1899; clk., res. mag., King William's Town and distrb., stamps, 1900; sec., plague admstr., 1903; 2nd cls. examr., control and audit dept., Cape, 1905; inland rev. dept., 1910; contr. and audr.-gen.'s dept., 1912; senr. clk., 1912; reor., rev., Port Elizabeth, 1916; survr., rev., Pretoria, 1921; Cape Town, 1929; reor., rev., Pretoria, 1930; ditto, Johannesburg, 1932.

MARSHALL, EDWARD FOSTER, B.A. (Oxon.).—B. 1888; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Dec., 1912; addt. Kurunegala kach., Jan., 1913; Badulla kach.,
Mar., 1913; pol. mag., Matale, May, 1917; asst. govt. agt., Mullaitivu, Sept., 1918; pol. mag., Gampola, May, 1920; asst. govt. agt., Galle, Sept., 1923; pol. mag., Matara, Dec., 1923; dist. judge, Badulla, Apr., 1925; pol. mag., Avissawella, Nov., 1926; dist. judge, Avissawella, Jan., 1928; ditto., Badulla, Feb., 1929; pol. mag., Matale, Jan., 1930; asst. sttlmt. offr., Nov., 1931.

MARSHALL, FREDERICK CHARLES.—B. 1880; ed. Repton and Camborne Sch. of Mines; distlmt. offr., Negri Sembilan, Nov., 1901; inspr., mines, Mar., 1902; mag., Dec., 1902; asst. warden, mines, Pahang, Jan., 1904; dep. asst. sup't, census, Oct., 1910; mag., Raub, Mar., 1912; collr. Raub, July, 1912; seconded for service in S. Nigeria, Nov., 1913 to Mar., 1914; warden, mines, Kodah, June, 1918; warden, mines, F.M.S.; warden, mines, Johore, Feb., 1921; comsnr. under land enact., Oct., 1922; asst. regiir., sup. ct., July, 1931; ag. 1st mag. in addn., Dec., 1931.

MARSHALL, CAPT. REGINALD CHARLES, M.A. (Oxon.), Diploma of Forestry.—B. 1893; exhib. Queen's Coll., Oxford, 1911; hon. mods. (maths.), 2nd cls. hon., 1912; 2nd lieut., Worc. Regt., Aug., 1914; Gallipoli, 1915 (wounded); Mesopotamia, 1916 (wounded); lieut., 9th Batt. Worc. Regt., France, 1917-18 (wounded and prisoner); capt., 1st Batt. Worc. Regt., B.A. (Oxon.), 1919; diploma of forestry (with distinction—placed head of the list), 1920; M.A., 1920; forestry comsnr., 1920-22; instr., forestry schl., Forest of Dean; asst. comsnr., national savings comttee., 1922; dep. conservator, forests, Trinidad and Tobago, 1923; conservator, forests, 1923; mem., bd. of agr., 1923.

MARSHALL, REGINALD HENRY.—B. 1890; ed. Dulwich; active serv., Aug., 1914 to Mar., 1919; col. audit dept., May, 1919; audr., Seychelles, June, 1919; audr., Br. Honduras, Aug., 1924; C.A.D., Oct., 1927; dep. audr., Tanganyika Territory, July, 1930.

MARSLAND, HERBERT, B.Sc. (Ag.)—B. 1899; ed. Ashton-under-Lyne Secondary Schil.; Coll. of Agr., Holmes Chapel, 1917; N.D.A., Harris Inst., Preston, 1921; N.D., W. of Scotland Coll. of Dairying, 1921; B.Sc. Univ. of Edinburgh, 1924; Imp. Coll. Trop. Agr., Trinidad, 1924; inspr. agr., Sudan govt., 1925; cotton investigator, Tanganyika Territory, 1928.

MARSTON, S.—Treasy. asst., Kenya, Jan., 1917; senr. asst. treas., June, 1923; dep. treas., Uganda, 1925; ag. treas., 1926 and 1929; senr. asst. currency offr., June, 1928; mem. rly. advisory coun. (Kenya and Uganda), July, 1929; treas., Uganda, 1930.

MARTIN, GASTON PACROS DE, M.B.E., M.A., Trin. Coll., Dub.—B. 1874; asst. maat., Queen's Coll., Hong Kong, 1904; ag. inspr., English schls., 1913-14; postal censor, 1914-16; head mast., Yaumati Schil., 1920; inspr., English schls. and sec., bd. of educn., 1924; ag. dir., educn., June, 1930.

MARTIN, JOHN MILLER, B.A.—B. 1904; ed. Edinburgh Acad. and Oxford; class. schol., Corpus Christi Coll., 1923-27; 1st cls. class. mods., 1924; B.A., 1927; apptd. after compet. exam., asst. prin., Dom's Office, 2nd Nov., 1927.

MARTIN, KENNETH SEFTON, B.A. (Oxon.)—B. 1888; asst. dist. comsnr., S. Nigeria, 1911; supervisor, cust., 2nd grade, 1911; 1st grade, 1919; senr. collr., 1929.

MARTIN, LEWIS VERNON.—B. 1902; entd. C.O., 10th Sept., 1917; apptd. after compet. exam., cler. offr., C.O., 17th Mar., 1920.

MARTIN, PETER HENRY, A.F.C., M.A., B.M., B.Ch. (Oxon.), M.R.C.P. (Lond.), D.T.M. & H. (Eng.)—B. 1896; pathologist, Inst., Med. Research, F.M.S., Sept., 1928; bacteriologist, Dec., 1931.

MARWICK, ALLAN GRAHAM, O.B.E. (1925).—B. 1877; served in Natal civ. serv., 1895 to 1899; served Anglo-Boer war, 1899-1901; sub. native comsnr., Mbabane, Swaziland, Jan., 1903 to Mar., 1907; asst. comsnr., ditto, Mar., 1907; asst. comsnr., Hlatikulu, Swaziland, Aug., 1916; mem. Swaziland-Portuguese bndry. comsnr., 1920; asst. comsnr., Mbabane and ag. dep. res. comsnr., Oct., 1932.

MASON, GERALD BOYELL.—Ed. Harrison Coll., Barbados; matric., London Univ., 1890; joined London hosp., 1890; passed prelim. scientific, 1892; M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.), 1896, certif., London Schil. of Trop. Med., 1909; D.P.H., Cambridge, 1917; med. offr., No. 4 dist., Antigua, 1903; ag. comsnr., Virgin Is., 1904; surg.-lieut., Antigua def. force, 1904; med. and med. offr., Anguilla and dep. judge of sup. et., Leeward Is., Jan., 1905 to Sept., 1906; med. offr., No. 6 dist., Nevis, 1906; med. offr., dist. "D", and mag. dist. "F", Dominica, 1907; med. offr., St. Vincent, 1909-12; temp. capt., R.A.M.C.; med. offr. in charge of troops, Cambridge, 1916-19; founder and hon. sec., W. Indian Club, 1897-8; founder and hon. sec., West India Red Cross Soc'y., 1921-1924; dir., med. and health dept., Bermuda, Aug., 1924.

MASON, H., A.M.Inst.T.—B. 1884; accts. clk., 1st grade, Uganda Rly., Apr., 1912; asst. ch. acctnt., Uganda Rly., Sept., 1916; dep. ch. acctnt., Tanganyika Territory rly., Sept., 1920; ag. ch. acctnt. on various occasions 1920-30; ch. acct., Gold Coast rly., 1930.

MASSEY, T. H.—Med. offr., E.A.P., Jan., 1913; senr. med. offr., Kenya, Oct., 1923.

MASTEN, HON. CORNELIUS ARTHUR.—B. 1857, Quebec; educ. parish dist. schil., La Colle; La Colle Academy; Victoria Univ., Coburg, Ont. (graduated with hon., May, 1879); mathematical master, high schil., Orillia, Ont., 1879-1880; entered law soc. of Upper Canada, Oct., 1880; called to the bar, 1883; K.C. (Ont.), and bencher of the law soc. of Upper Canada, 1908; comsnr. to inquire into the Insurance situation in Ont. with a view to improvements in the law; pres., Alumni Assoc. of Toronto Univ.; chmn. exec. comttee. of the speaker's patriotic league; author of "Masten Company Law in Canada"; justice of the sup. ct. of Ontario, Nov., 1915.

MASTERS, HON. ROBERT, M.L.C.—B. 1879; ed. at Brunnerston, N.Z.; mem., N.Z. house of reps., 1919-26; mem. and dep. leader of leg. coun. and mem. of exec. coun. without portfolio, 1930; min. of educn. and min. of industries and commerce, 1931.

MASTERTON-SMITH, SIR JAMES EDWARD, K.C.B. (1919), C.B. (1915).—B. 1878; ed. Harrow (schol.) and Hartford Coll., Oxford (schol.); ent. home civ. serv. (cls. I.), admity., 1901; priv. sec. to 2nd sea lord, 1904-8; priv. sec. to perm. sec., 1908-10; priv. sec. to successive 1st lords of the admity., 1910-17; asst. sec., min. of munitions, Sept., 1917 to Jan., 1919; asst. sec. (addnl.), W.O. and Air Miny., 1919-20; joint perm. sec., miny. of labour, 1920; perm. under-seo. of state for the colonies, 30th Aug., 1921; sec. to the Order of St. Michael and St. George; mem. of the offi. side of the National Whitley Coun.; ret., 1925; Offr. of the Belgian Order of the Crown.
MASTERTON-SMITH, PERCIVAL FRANK, M.C.—B. 1895; ed. Christ's Hosp. and Wadham Coll., Oxford (hons. mod. hist.); B.A., 1921; R. Fusiliers, 1914-16; 60th Rifles, 1916-19; M.C., 1917; capt., res. of Offrs., 60th Rifles; admin. offr., Nigeria, 26th Jan., 1922.

MATEER, EDWARD JOHN.—Ed. Foyle Coll. and Taunton Sch.; astt. treas., Uganda, July 1920; senr. astt. treas., 1931.

MATHER, NORMAN FREDERICK HUGH.—B. 1890; ed. Merchant Taylor's Schl. and Hertford Coll., Oxford (schol.); cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1913; served in Rifle Brig., Dec., 1915-Sept., 1919; astt. sec. to rea., Selangor, Nov., 1919; astt. dist. offr., Mar., 1921; regis., war serv. land grant scheme, S. Feb., 1922; sec. to rea., Pahang, Dec., 1923; mag., Seremban, July, 1925; offr., cls. I.A., Nov., 1925; chmn., sany. bd., Seremban, Aug., 1926; cls. II, Nov., 1930; astt. advr., Segamat, Johore, May, 1931; dist. offr., Larut and regis., titles, Perak, Mar., 1932.

MATHERS, FREDERICK FRANCIS, K.C., LL.B.—B. 1871; ed. schls. in Halifax, Nova Scotia, Dalhousie law schl. and Harvard law schl.; called to the bar, 1892; dep. prov. sec. and clk. of exec. coun., N.S., 1902; also regis. of joint stock companies, 1909; now deputy atty.-gen.

MATHESON, CAPT. C. L. T., M.C.—Commissioned in Royal Engineers, 1909; astt. dir. of surv., G. Coast, 1914; Togoland campaign, 1914; Camerons, 1914-16; France with Field Coy., R.E., 1916-17; W.O., 1918; dep. dir. topographical surveys, G. Coast, 1920.

MATHEWS, ALAN FRANK, F.S.A.A. (Incorporated Accountant).—B. 1891; astt. audr., external audit dept., S.S. and F.M.S., Aug., 1919; ag. senr. astt. audr., on various occasions, 1920-23; astt., audit office, Singapore, July to Sept., 1922; senr. astt. audr., Feb., 1923; ag. audr.-gen. and ag. dir., extern. audit, S.S., Oct. to Dec., 1930.

MATHEWS, ARNOLD BURNETT.—B. 1898; ed. Shrewsbury (schl.) and Magdalene Coll., Cambridge (cls. schl.); sub-lieut., R.N.V.R., 1917-19; 2nd cls., Pl. classical tripus, 1920; B.A., 1920; 2nd cls., anthropological tripus, 1922; astt. dist. offr., N.P. Nigeria, Jan., 1923; astt. sec., N.P. secretariat, Feb., 1926; astt. sec., Nigerian secretariat, Aug., 1927; clk. to exec. and leg. couns., Apr.-Sept., 1928; astt., C.O., July, 1929.

MATHIESON, HON. JOHN ALEXANDER, K.C.—B. 1863; ed. Harrington Gram. Schl., Prince of Wales' Coll., Taught Schl., Desable Gram. Schl., P.E.I., read law with McLean and Macdonald; called to the P.E.I. bar, 1893; K.C., 1905; el. to legislature for King's county, 1900; re-el., 1904, 1908 and 1912; leader of the opposition, 1903; premier and atty.-gen., 2nd Dec., 1911; ch. just., P.E.I., 13th June, 1917.

MATTHEWS, ERNEST LEWIS, K.C., C.M.G. (1914).—Called to the bar, Inner Temple; law adviser to Transvaal govt., June, 1902; law adviser to govt. of Union of S. Africa, 31st May, 1910; puisne judge, Natal prov. divn., 1926.

MATTHEWS, SIR JOHN BROMHEAD, KT. BACH. (1911).—B. 1864; barrister-at-law, Inner Temple, 1890, N.E. circuit; ag. solr.-gen., S. Settims, Oct., 1902, to May, 1903; M.L.C., S. Settims, 1901 and 1904; pres. of Moslem charities coman., S. Settims, 1903; atty.-gen., Bahamas, 1907; M.L.C., Bahamas, 1907-1909; K.C., Bahamas, 1909; atty.-gen., S. Settims, 1909; ch. just., Bahamas, Jan., 1910; resig., 1911.

MATTHEWS, LESLIE GARD.—Ed. Plymouth; Oxford Univ. O.T.C., 1915; O.A.S., France, 1916 and 1917, Lanc. Fusiliers; Mesopotamia, 1917-21, astt., Indian Army and Iraq Levies; Arab rebellion, Iraq, 1920 (med. and clasp); astt. treas., Somaliland, June, 1921; dist. pol. offr., Somaliland, Feb., 1923; astt. comanr., pol., Nigeria, 1926.

MAVOR, WILLIAM DAVID.—B. 1881; ed. Heriot Watt Coll. (Edin.), foreman, photo-litho secn., F.M.S., Oct., 1910; mily. serv., Highland F. Amb., Sept., 1915; demob., Mar., 1919; astt. supt., photo-litho secn., Jan., 1921; ch. photo-litho, surv. dept., F.M.S., July, 1923.

MAVROGORDATO, ARTHUR STEPHEN, O.B.E. (1928).—B. 1886; ed. at Oakham Schl., Rutland; elk., pol. headqrs., Cyprus, Nov., 1903; inspr. of mil. pol., Cyprus, May, 1905; in charge of pol. detachment, Kyrenia, 1907-1909; gov. of prison and dep. coroner; passed govt. exams. in modern Greek and Turkish; in command of Papho dist. several occasions; detailed for special duty in Larnaca dist. in connection with Limassol riots, May-June, 1912; astt. comanr. of police, Sierra Leone, June, 1913; J.P. and dep. coroner, 1913; ag. comanr. of police, also sheriff, prison visiting justice, and govt. nominee on city coun. of Freetown, and performing duties of marshal of the Admiralty prize ct., May to Nov., 1915, Dec., 1916, to May, 1917, Feb. to Apr., 1918, and from Aug. to Dec., 1918; ag. harbr. and detaining offr. under mil. authorities, May, 1916, to May, 1917, and May, 1918, to Mar., 1919; ag. dist. comanr. in headqrs. dist., S. Leone, Feb.-Mar., 1919; dep. inspr.-gen., police and prisons, Palestine, Dec., 1922; ag. inspr.-gen., pol. and prisons, Apr., 1924; commdt., ditto, Apr., 1926; rep. Palestine govt. at internat. pol. confce., Antwerp, Sept., 1930; inspr.-gen., constab., Trinidad, July, 1931; mem., leg. coun.

MAY, HENRY O'HARA, M.D., B.C.H., B.A.O. (Univ. Dubl.), D.P.H. (Irol.)—B. 1878; med. offr., W.A.M.S., Apr., 1907; med. offr., health, Nov., 1911; junr. sany. offr., Aug., 1916; dep. dir., sany. serv., Sierra Leone, Oct., 1922; dep. dir., health serv., Gold Coast, June, 1926.

MAXWELL, COL. GEOFFREY ARCHIBALD PRENTICE, D.S.O., M.V.O., M.C., Officer Ordre de Leopold, Officer Legion d'Honneur, Belgian Croix de Guerre, French Croix de Guerre, M.Inst.T.—B. 1885; R.M.A., Woolwich, 1902; R.E., 1904; Nigeria Barokano rly., 1908-11; survey, E.A.P., 1912-14; European War, 1914-18 (ment. seven times in despa.); inter-allied comm. of control, rly.s., occupied territory, 1919; communications sec., sup. economic coun., 1919-20; gen. man., Tanganyika rly., 1920.

MAXWELL, GERALD VERNER, G.M.G.(1931).—B. 1877; ed. Bedford Gram. Schl. (exhibitioner) and Peter-house, Camb. (scholar); cadet, Fiji, Apr., 1898; ag. regis.-genl. and regis. of titles, Dec., 1898; stip. mag., Dec., 1900; astt. native comanr., Jan., 1904; native lands comanr., Jan., 1906; ag. astt. col. sec. and ag. astt. rec.-gen., Oct., 1909; ag. rec.-gen., Dec., 1909, to Nov., 1910; chmn., native lands coman., 1912; ag. sec. for native affairs (joint), Mar., 1917; temporarily M.L.C., May, 1917; ch. native comanr., Kenya Colony, May, 1921; mem. exec. and legis. councils.

MAXWELL, SIR WM. GEORGE, K.B.E.(1924), C.M.G. (1915); Royal Humane Society's med. (1882).—B. 1871; ed. at Clifton Coll.; barrister-at-law, Inner Temp.; jun. offr., Perak, F.M.S., Mar., 1891 astt. mag., Kinta, Apr., 1892; ag. collr. and mag., Kuantan, Pahang, Aug., 1895; ag. supt. of Ulu Pahang, Aug., 1896;
regim. of cts., Kinta, Perak, Feb., 1899; ag. asst. sec. to govt., Perak, Feb., 1900; ag. collr. of land rev., Larut, regim. of titles, Perak, North, and warden of mines, Perak, North, Mar., 1901; ag. sen. mag., Selangor and Negri Sembilan, Jan., 1903; ag. sen. mag., Perak, Aug., 1903; ag. sec. to res., Perak, Apr., 1904; dist. offr., Dindinga, Aug., 1906; dep. pub. pros., Singapore, 1906; sol.-gen., S. Settmts., Aug., 1906; ag. atty.-gen., S. Settmts., Mar., 1908; British adviser to govt. of Kedah, July, 1909; ag. col. sec., S. Stltmts., 1914; ag. sec. to high commnr., Malay States and Brunei, 1915; ag. col. sec., S. Stltmts., Jan., 1916; ag. British res., Perak, Dec., 1916 to May, 1917; ag. sec. to high commnr., Malay States and Brunei, June, 1917; vice-chmn., food control comteee., S.S. and F.M.S.; vice-chmn., shipping control comteee., S.S.; pres. rubber comm., 1918; pres., Singapore housing comm.; pres., Singapore centenary comteee.; general adviser to govt., Johore, June, 1918; ag. col. sec., S. Stltmts., Dec., 1918; ag. British res., Perak, Sept., 1919; Br. res., Perak, Dec., 1919; ob. sec. to govt., F.M.S., Sept., 1920; ret., 1926; publications, "Perak Land Laws (past and present)," "The Laws of the S. Stltmts., 1877-1903," "The Laws of the S. Stltmts., 1827-1907," "In Malay Forests."

MAXWELL-ANDERSON, GEORGE BARTLET.—B. 1880; ed. Gordon's Coll., Aberdeen; clk., war office, Jan., 1900; 2nd cls. clk., G.P.O., Johannesburg, Dec., 1902; transf. to exec. and legis. councils dept.; 2nd cls. clk., June, 1903; 1st cls. clk., July, 1905; acct.'s clk. and cashier, Transvaal agt-general's office, London, Oct., 1907; asst. acctnt., Apl., 1908; clk., P.W.D., Nyasaaland, June, 1909; chief clk., secretariat, Apl., 1914; ag. asst. chief sec., Aug., 1916; on re-organisation of secretariat apptd. 2nd asst. sec., Aug., 1919; ag. 1st asst. sec., Aug., 1919; ag. ch. sec., June to Nov., 1920; admin. offr., 1st grade, July, 1922; ag. 1st asst. sec. Mar. to Nov., 1922; ag. prov. commnr. on two occasions, 1927-29; prov. commnr., July, 1929.

MAYBIN, JOHN ALEXANDER.—B. 1889; M.A. (Edin.); cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Jan., 1914; attached to the Badulla kach, Jan., 1914; ag. office assist. to govt. agt., July, 1914, and Jan., 1915; addtl. dist. judge and pol. mag., Badulla in adn., June, 1915; pol. mag., Panadura, Mar., 1916; on mily. duty, 1917; ag. pol. mag., Kandy, July, 1919; 2nd finan. asst. to chmn., mun. coun., Colombo, Mar., 1920; finan. asst., Colombo Municipality, Nov., 1920; addnl. ass't. col. sec., Jan., 1922; landing survr., Colombo cust., Mar., 1923; 3rd ass't. col. sec., Feb., 1924; 2nd ass't. col. sec. and clk., leg. coun., Mar., 1925; asst. regim., co-op. socs., Apr., 1928.

MAYHEW, ARTHUR INNES, C.I.E.—B. 1878; ed. at Winchester and New Coll., Oxford (achl.); B.A., 1901; Berlin and Jena Univ.; ent. Indian educnl. serv., 1903; educnl. advisor, Hyderabad State, 1910; dir., pub. instrn., Cent. Prov., 1913; ag. educn. commnr. to govt. of India, 1921; mem., Eton Coll. staff, 1922-29; joint sec. to advisory comteee. on educn. in the C.O., 1929; author of "The Education of India," "Christianity and the Government of India."

MAYLE, NORMAN LESLIE.—B. 1899; apptd. after compet. exam., asst. clk., C.O., Oct., 1917; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920; promoted to clk. of the 2nd div., Feb., 1920; on mil serv. from Sept., 1917 to Sept., 1919; cler. offr. higher grade, 7th July, 1923; asst. prin., 16th Nov., 1928; ag. pvte. sec. to parly. U.S. of S. for the Cols., 2nd Feb., 1932; pvte. sec., do., 18th Apr., 1932.

MAYNARD, PROY.—B. 1903; apptd. after compet. exam., cler. offr., C.O., 15th Oct., 1920.

MEAD, JOHN PHILLIPS.—B. 1886; dip. forestry (Oxon); ed. Charterhouse Sch., Royal Indian Engrng. Coll. MEADE, CHARLES RICHARD.—Copyist, treasy. and post office dept., Montserrat, Oct., 1907; 5th clk., Apr., 1912; 4th clk., Nov., 1912; govt. offr., Sandy Point, St. Kitts-Nevia, Nov., 1915; clk., treasy., Virgin Is., May, 1917; clk., exec. council; prin., Apr., 1927; ag. postmr., regir. and provost marshal, Virgin Is. circuit, Mar. to July, 1928; prin., treasy., Dominica, Dec., 1928; ag. treasy., 1931.

MEADE, CAPT. JOSEPH MICHAEL, B.A. (T.C.D.), Barrister-at-Law (King's Inns, Dublin).—B. 1889; European mast., S.S. and F.M.S., Dec., 1920; asst. mast., King Edward VII schl., Taiping, Feb., 1921; asst. inspr., schls., Perak, Jan., 1923, Sept., 1925 and Apr., 1929; inspr., schls., N. MEADEN, HENRY, M.B.E. (1831).—B. 1882; asst. warden, Tobago, 1919; asst. warden, St. Patrick, 1922; mag. warden, Tobago, 1st Apr., 1926.

MEDWAY, F. W.—Imp. serv. (acctnt.-gen.'s dept., G.P.O.), 1901-2; clk., G.P.O., Bloemfontein, Nov., 1902; clk., treasy., O.F.S., May, 1908; senr. clk., treasy., Union of S. Africa, Apr., 1913; senr. clk., inland rev. dept., Dec., 1916; prin. clk., Apr., 1917; ch. clk., April, 1928.

MEEHAN, JOHN FRANCIS.—G.W.R., 1903-14; ent. traffic dept., Gold Coast govt. rly., Mar., 1914; seconded Togoland mily. rly., traffic offr., 1918-19; asst. traffic supt., Tanganyika rly., Aug., 1920; traffic supt., April, 1928.

MEEK, A. I., L.R.C.P., L.R.C.S., D.P.H. (Edin.), L.R.F.P. & S. (Glas.).—B. 1889; R.A.M.C., Aug., 1918 to May, 1920; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, May, 1922; senr. health offr., Apr., 1930.

OMTEE. in addn., 1930; mag. and dist. offr., N. district, New Territories, Mar., 1931.

MELLISH, CECIL EDWARD.—B. 1872; ed. Sherborne Sch.; asst. elk., cts., Jamaica, 1892; called to bar, Lincoln's Inn, 1910; elk. of cts., Jamaica, 1912; regis. of titles, Jamaica, 1st Apr., 1923.

MELLISH, HON. HUMPHREY.—B. 1862; ed. MELLON, BAGNALL HARVEY, M.R.C.S., Eng., L.R.C.P., Lond., D.P.H., Dublin Univ., F.R.C.V.S.—B. 1888; ed. Univ. Coll., Dublin; research staff, dept., agr., Ireland, 1910; late capt., R.A.V.C. and R.A.M.C., 1914; 2nd health offr. of port, Hong Kong, 1921; health offr., 1923.

MENENDEZ, SIR M. RAYMOND, KT. BAOR. (1906).—Ed. Emman. Coll., Camb.; LL.B., Camb., 1890; barrister-at-law, Inner Temp.; ag. stip. and circuit mag., etc., and judge of com. pleas, Bahamas, 1892-4; dist. commrs., Lagos, Aug., 1894; ag. MENTZ, HON. HENDRIK.—B. 1877; formerly M.L.A., Transvaal; M.L.A. for Zoutpansberg till 1924; min. of lands, Union of S. Africa, 1916; and ag. min. of defence, 1918; min. of defence, 1920-24.

MEREWETHER, SIR EDWARD MARSH, K.C.M.G. (1916); K.C.V.O. (1907); C.V.O. (1903); C.M.G. (1902).—B. 1858; ed. Harrow; cadet, S.S., Oct., 1880; confirmed, Jan., 1883; Malay interp. with H.M.S. MERRICK, JOHN EDWARD SIEGFRIED, O.B.E. (1931).—B. 1888; ed. Winchester and Univ. Coll., Oxford; B.A. 1911; asst. dist. commr., Uganda Prot., 1912; 3rd asst. sec., 1913; 2nd asst. sec., 1916; senr. asst. sec., E. Africa Prot., Nov., 1919; asst. col. sec. METHVEN, STUARTSON COLLARD.—Clk., oust., Fiji, Nov., 1912; elk., res. commr.'s dept., Gilbert and Ellice Is., Colly., Nov., 1913; dep. commr., W. Pacific, Oct., 1918; ag. dist. offr., Dec., 1918; dist. offr., July, 1926.

METIVIER, CAPT. HARRY VINCENT MERCER, O.B.E.—Gov't. vet. surg. commr. of animals, Trinidad, Dec., 1920.

METZGEN, MONRAD SIGFRID, M.B.E. (1932).—B. 1893; temp. elk. to keeper of prisons, B. MEWS, ARTHUR, C.M.G. (1918).—Acct., gov. telegraphs, Newfndld., 1893; elk. to final sec., 1894; fincl. elk., col. sec.'s office, 1895; dep. col. sec., 1898; regis. of joint stock companies, 1899; J.P., 1913; censor of telegraphs, cables and wireless stations, 1914; mem., St. John's defence commr., 1915; dep. press censor, 1915.

MEYER, LEOPOLD DONNELLY.—B. 1889; survey cadet, Queensland, 1909-11; survey br., state forests dept., May, 1911; lic. land survr., Victoria, Oct., 1913; survr., Kedah, Apr., 1914; mil'y, surv., 1917-19; demob., 1919; asst. supt., rev. surveys, F.M.S., Apr., 1923; supt., surveys Trengganu, Sept., 1927; ag. supt., surveys, Kelantan, June, 1930.

MICALLEF, SIR RICHARD, K.C.M.G. (1906), C.M.G. MICHELIN, WILLIAM PLUNKETT.—B. 1872; barrister-at-law, Middle Temple; entd. col. serv.,

Coast, Mar., 1906; ag. chief regar. and sheriff 1909; acted as solr.-gen. on several occasions during 1908-1911; pol. mag., Coomassie, Feb., 1911; ag. circuit judge, Sierra Leone, Jan., Apl., 1913; pol. mag. and coroner, Gibraltar, June, 1913; acted as atty.-gen. on several occasions during the years 1913-1919; 2nd puisne judge, Leeward Islands, Nov., 1919; 1st puisne judge, Aug., 1920; ag. ch. just. Nov., 1920 to Mar., 1921 and from Dec., 1922 to Mar., 1923; prepared revd. edn. of statutes of St. Kitts and Nevis, 1922; puisne judge, Gold Coast, July, 1923; ag. ch. just. on various occasions, 1925-31.

MIDDLETON, H. HALE, B.A. (1907).—B. 1885; ed. Warwick Schol. and Hertford Coll., Oxford (hons. jurisprudence); astt. res., N. MIDDLETON, SIR JOHN, K.C.M.G. (1931), K.B.E. (1924). C.M.G. (1916).—B. 1870; ed. Sedbergh and Univ. of Edin.; M.A.; astt. dist. comsnr., S. MIFSUD, EDWARD R., C.M.G. (1932), O.B.E. (1927), M.B.E. MILES, GEORGE COCKBURN, B.A., (Oxon.)—B. 1898; on mil. serv., Mar., 1917; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., May, 1921; attd., Jaffna kach., June, 1921; pol. mag., Puttalam, Aug., 1922; office astt., Galle kach., Apr., 1924; ditto, Anuradhapura kach., Feb., 1926; 4th astt. col. sec., May, 1927; 3rd astt., col. sec., May, 1928; temp. attd. to C.O. as astt. prin., Sept., 1930—Feb., 1931; astt. ch. sec., July, 1931.
